title: Evaluation of a New MR Pulse Sequence to Quantify Liver Iron Concentration
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if a new MR pulse sequence is accurate in determining how much iron is in the liver.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Undergoing liver biopsy for suspected or known hemochromatosis
* Undergoing liver biopsy for living-related liver donation evaluation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to MRI
study_population: Gastroenterology Clinic; Liver Transplant Center; Surgery Clinic
